```python

# Compute all-time high and low from pre-aggregated non-foil paper price snapshots (original set)

cards = {
    "Oko, Thief of Crowns": [38.50, 41.75, 40.00, 37.55, 33.20, 28.10, 24.00, 19.50, 15.25],
    "Once Upon a Time": [29.90, 27.20, 25.00, 22.00, 18.00, 10.50, 7.00, 2.50, 2.10],
    "Veil of Summer": [13.50, 16.40, 15.10, 12.00, 11.00, 8.50, 6.25, 5.80]
}

for card, prices in cards.items():
    high = max(prices)
    low = min(prices)
    print(f"{card} -> High: ${high:.2f}, Low: ${low:.2f}")
```
